g.text: F157 the Google integration suite: a visitor asks the guesthouse for a room
a room for two, next Friday and
refresh token for an access token
both nights are free at R1 200 a night;

text.tspan: The tool asks for a token for the turn's tenant and one scope; only the accounts library ever holds the refresh token, and a booking waits for the visitor's yes.
